result.title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
result.summary: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

AI.brief_summary: ReSolve 提出一种免训练的推理流程，在候选答案不一致或无法解析时调用模型检查已有推导，把生成的解答纳入有界循环，并用答案分布控制器决定是否触发；在竞赛数学题上以少于多次采样的 token 取得更高正确数，消融显示移除可见推导会降低准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 主线为纯文本推理，但其「选择性复用候选推导 + 有界循环 + 选择性触发」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 候选状态复用、THINK/STOP 触发与计算预算分配提供可核查线索。
